title: Finding Structure in Time
before: Neural nets processed fixed-size inputs with no notion of order.
problem: Language arrives as a sequence, and context from earlier words has to persist.
breakthrough: A recurrent hidden layer that feeds its own previous state back in, giving the network a memory of what came before.
why: It established that sequence can live in a network's internal state rather than in its input window.
next: LSTM fixed the gradient problems this design exposed.
inherits: The idea of a running hidden state summarising everything read so far.
